//: Accessibility assists for timing (docs/gameplay-overhaul/08-difficulty-and-accessibility.md). Independent of difficulty: any level goes with any difficulty. An assist only ever makes timing easier, within the bounds in src/systems/challenge/difficulty.js (ASSIST_TUNING), and never decides an outcome: fumbles and slips still count, and a challenge's record lists every assist that helped.

off.label: Off
off.summary: Timing bars and the sash tension play at their normal pace.

light.label: Light
light.summary: Slower markers, a little more green, a longer clock and clearer cues. Fumbles and slips still count.

strong.label: Strong
strong.summary: Much slower markers, a wide green, half again the time and clearer cues. Fumbles and slips still count.

summary.off: Strict timing bars don't help after a miss.
summary.on: Strict timing bars help after a miss, like the old bar: the green widens, then steadies. Fumbles still count.
